title: rmcolq/bdbv-pipeline-beast-nf
description: BEAST XML generation and postprocessing for Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) phylodynamics, picking up from the final alignment of bdbv-pipeline.

input_options.title: Input options
input_options.description: Provide --alignment to generate BEAST XMLs, --beast_dir to postprocess BEAST output, or both.

alignment.title: Alignment
alignment.description: Final alignment from bdbv-pipeline (Part 1). Generates BEAST XMLs

beast_dir.title: BEAST output directory
beast_dir.description: Directory with BEAST .log and .trees files. Runs postprocessing

output_options.title: Output options
output_options.description: Where results are written and how they are named.

run_name.title: Run name
run_name.description: Label used in the default prefix (default: today, YYYYMMDD)

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Prefix for output file names (default: bdbv_<run_name>)

beast_options.title: BEAST XML options
beast_options.description: BEAST XML generation from the final alignment. One XML is generated per template.

template_sg.title: SkyGrid template
template_sg.help_text: Defaults to templates/GTR_SG.template.xml. Pass your own file, or use false to skip.

template_egc.title: EGC template
template_egc.help_text: Defaults to templates/GTR_EGC.template.xml. Pass your own file, or use false to skip.

anchor_date.title: Anchor date
anchor_date.description: SkyGrid anchor date; the grid extends from this date to the latest sample

postprocess_options.title: Postprocessing options
postprocess_options.description: Postprocessing of BEAST logs and trees.

burnin.title: Burnin
burnin.description: Fraction of samples/trees discarded as burnin

min_ess.title: Minimum ESS
min_ess.description: Minimum acceptable ESS for key parameters

force_low_ess.title: Force low ESS
force_low_ess.description: Continue to tree postprocessing even if key parameters are below the ESS threshold

treeannotator.title: TreeAnnotator
treeannotator.description: TreeAnnotator executable used for the MCC tree

miscellaneous_options.title: Miscellaneous Options
miscellaneous_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

docs.intro: BEAST XML generation and postprocessing for Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) phylodynamics, picking up from the final alignment of bdbv-pipeline.
